hero.headline: You pick the destination. We handle the bureaucracy.
hero.subhead: Kimere is the startup revolutionizing global student mobility. From choosing your university to getting a visa, all the way through funding, documents and housing. We build a custom roadmap to let you study anywhere you want, tearing down every obstacle.
hero.ctaInstitution: I'm a university or an agency

routing.heading: Four profiles. One clear path.
routing.body: Your needs are unique, whether you are a student with a clear goal or still deciding, a university seeking international talent or an agency looking to expand. Pick your profile and discover how we can accelerate your goals.

boxes.title: I want to study abroad
boxes.body: Already have a destination in mind? Perfect. We take care of your application, build a bulletproof visa file for your consulate, handle the ISEE for your scholarships and find you a real home without nasty surprises.

boxes.title: I don't know where to start
boxes.body: Overwhelmed by choices across courses, countries or budgets? We help you find clarity. Fill out the questionnaire, we will research your actual options and you will finish the session with a strategic plan instead of a thousand doubts.

boxes.title: I represent a university
boxes.body: Attracting international students means navigating a bureaucracy that makes no sense to outsiders. We support you with targeted seminars to turn interest into actual enrollments.

boxes.title: I run a recruitment agency
boxes.body: You find the talent, we guarantee a safe landing. We become your operational arm on the ground, with roles and commissions put in writing before the first student even moves.

strengths.heading: We speak your language. And we know your culture.
strengths.body: Studying abroad is a massive challenge. Our real secret? A young, diverse and globally distributed team. When you trust Kimere, you speak with someone from your own country in the language you actually think in, instantly eliminating any cultural barrier.

points.title: A consultant who gets you instantly
points.body: We pair you with a professional of your exact same nationality. That unspoken cultural understanding saves endless conversations, and it's the exact reason foreign universities trust us.

points.title: A global network with zero borders
points.body: No call centers or rigid offices. We are an agile team of specialists ready to support you across any time zone. Nobody gets bounced from one department to another.

points.title: Seven languages and in-house documents
points.body: Our native teachers directly handle the translation of your documents as well. No slow middlemen, just translations that begin the exact day you ask for them.

bureaucracy.eyebrow: The part that actually stops people
bureaucracy.heading: Bureaucracy will no longer be your nightmare.
bureaucracy.body: It is rarely an admission test that stops a dream. What blocks you is a scholarship you didn't know existed, uncommunicated deadlines and an unrecognized diploma. This is exactly where we step in. Especially in Italy, our primary market, we solve the three biggest obstacles at their root.

items.title: Scholarships and ISEE calculation
items.body: The Italian university system relies on the ISEE, an economic indicator almost nobody abroad knows how to calculate. We reconstruct it for you and file your scholarship application right on time.

items.title: Translating and legalizing your diploma
items.body: Your foreign qualification must be legally valid. Our in-house professionals translate your documents and guide you through the complex legalization procedure, saving you months of pointless waiting.

items.title: Taxes, healthcare and bank accounts
items.body: Income brackets, health coverage and fiscal codes are boring and strictly sequential procedures. We walk you through them step by step to ensure no minor technicality costs you an academic year.

bureaucracy.limitHeading: What we cannot do (and you better know it upfront)
bureaucracy.limitBody: The CIMEA comparability statement or the evaluation of a foreign qualification are the exclusive responsibility of the authorities. No private entity can replace them. We will not promise you non-existent shortcuts, but we will prepare a flawless file to get you through the process smoothly. Anyone promising miracles is selling you a rejected application.

forUniversities.heading: Multiply your international student base
forUniversities.body: How much talent are you losing because of a rulebook nobody understands? A South American student might be entitled to scholarships or benefits they ignore, forcing them to enroll elsewhere. We bridge that gap and unlock enrollments.
forUniversities.seminarHeading: The first step is a Free Online Seminar
forUniversities.seminarBody: We analyze the pain points of the market you want to attract students from and offer your team a tailored training session. We explain exactly what the regulations demand, providing clear answers and official sources.
seminarPoints: A customized session focused entirely on your target foreign market
A practical deep dive into scholarships, fees and qualification recognition
Zero costs and no commercial strings attached for this first session
An operational summary that your office gets to keep forever

languageCourses.heading: Learn the language before you actually need it
languageCourses.body: The same team handling your translations also teaches you the language, creating a perfectly integrated ecosystem. Our online courses are taught by native professionals and adapt to your schedule, not a traditional school's timetable.

finalCta.heading: Didn't find your perfect fit?
finalCta.body: Not a problem. Every journey is unique, which is why we highly recommend booking a tailored Strategic Consultation. It is an intensive session where we build a real action plan, simply because we do the research on your case before we even meet.
finalCta.surveyNote: You will start by filling out a preliminary questionnaire. This is a crucial step that allows us to study your profile in advance and avoid wasting a single minute of our call on basic questions.
